intro.text: A lighteyed officer in the sixth battalion of Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Adolin Kholin was due to meet Reral but stopped to protect a woman being beaten by one of Sadeas's officers and walked her home instead. He gave Kaladin an emerald chip to tell Reral he would reschedule, but Kaladin, feeling talked down to, never delivered the message.
